title: Water Melon: modeled ₹432/qtl left, Kathua → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: March 2023: reported water Melon prices at Kathua and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 93% of 15 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹432 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 64 same-variety market pairs screened for water Melon in March 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: March 2023
scenes.caption: Kathua (Jammu and Kashmir) and Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported water Melon prices for the same variety and grade (Medium) on 15 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kathua reported a median ₹1,750 per quintal. Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹2,250 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹575/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹575 per quintal, and Kangra (Baijnath) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 110 km by road
scenes.caption: 110 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹24/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹354 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹241 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kangra (Baijnath) report, the rule selects 13 of 15 modeled shipping days. 13 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹432 per quintal (₹305 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Water Melon route from Kathua to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 93% of matched days in March 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹43,200, or ₹30,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to water Melon
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹24/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Water Melon route from Kathua to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 93% of matched days in March 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹43,200, or ₹30,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
